name: Planet Labs PBC
aka: Planet; Planet Labs Federal, Inc. (US government subsidiary); NYSE: PL
founder_backgrounds: Former NASA Ames scientists/engineers (PhoneSat lineage); Marshall remains CEO, Schingler Chief Strategy Officer. (Stable background; RECALL, HIGH)
total_disclosed_funding_usd: Public company since Dec 2021 SPAC merger (dMY Technology Group IV). Pre-listing venture funding roughly $300M+ (RECALL, MEDIUM). Trailing financials: Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 31, 2026) revenue $116M, +58% YoY; backlog ~$815M (+11% YoY), ~50% recognizable in 12 months, ~70% in 24 months (FACT, company release Sep 2026).
latest_valuation: Public market cap (not captured this session). Defense & Intelligence was ~70% of Q2 FY2027 revenue and D&I revenue incl. satellite services grew >90% YoY (FACT).

c4isr_products.name: PlanetScope / SkySat / Pelican / Tanager constellations
c4isr_products.description: Daily ~3m medium-resolution global scan (PlanetScope, ~200 Doves), ~50cm tasked SkySat, next-gen ~30cm-class Pelican (Pelican-2 carries NVIDIA Jetson edge compute; RECALL, MEDIUM), and Tanager hyperspectral.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: optical/hyperspectral collection; Process: ground processing to analysis-ready imagery, basemaps; Output: imagery, mosaics, tasking deliveries via API/direct downlink; Users: NGA/NRO/COCOM analysts, allied MoDs, civil.

c4isr_products.name: Planet Insights Platform (incl. Sentinel Hub) and Planetary Variables
c4isr_products.description: Cloud platform for search, streaming, analytics and ML-ready data; Sentinel Hub acquired from Sinergise (2023, FACT stable).
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: Planet + third-party EO data; Process: cloud analytics, change/vessel detection; Output: alerts, feeds, dashboards; Users: intelligence analysts, government monitoring cells.

c4isr_products.name: AI-enabled Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) and Global Monitoring Service (GMS)
c4isr_products.description: Analytic services sold to NGA: MDA across multiple Combatant Commands (Option Year 1, $22M) and GMS crisis-response monitoring ($8M award) (FACT, 2026).
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: daily scan imagery; Process: automated vessel/object detection and monitoring; Output: MDA feeds to NGA/COCOMs; Users: NGA, COCOM watch floors.

c4isr_products.name: Satellite Services (dedicated capacity / direct downlink)
c4isr_products.description: Sovereign-style offering: dedicated Pelican capacity and direct-to-ground downlink over defined regions (German government EUR 240M deal, 2025; JSAT commercial Pelican deal, RECALL).
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: customer tasking; Process: dedicated satellite capacity; Output: low-latency imagery to customer ground segment; Users: German government defense/intelligence, NATO.

exact_problem_solved: Persistent, daily, unclassified global optical coverage plus AI monitoring that lets defense/intelligence users detect change, monitor maritime activity and support planning without tasking scarce national assets; increasingly also sovereign, low-latency access via dedicated capacity.
primary_users: Allied MoD and intelligence analysts (Germany, NATO, other European customers)
primary_buyers: U.S. DoD/Navy (2026 announcements referenced by company; details insufficient)
hw_sw_mix: both - builds and operates its own satellites (hardware) and monetizes mostly through data subscriptions and cloud software/analytics; growing satellite-services line sells dedicated capacity.

apis_sdks_open_interfaces: Public, documented REST APIs: Data API, Orders API, Subscriptions API, Tasking API, plus Sentinel Hub APIs and Python SDK/CLI; STAC-style catalogs (FACT stable, company docs; not re-fetched this session).
security_classification_requirements: Unclassified commercial data by design; Planet Labs Federal handles U.S. government work; direct-downlink/dedicated capacity model addresses sovereignty needs. Facility/personnel clearance details: Public evidence insufficient.

evidence_prototype_to_production: Not a prototype-to-production model; Planet sells operational subscriptions. German dedicated-capacity deal converts pilot-style data sales into multi-year sovereign service (INFERENCE, MEDIUM).
